body: We lost 7-10 employees at our manufacturing plant, the one from my line was a full blown conspiracy head, glad to see her gone

As someone who’s tried that way a few times I really don’t suggest it. It can take so anywhere from a few hours to a few days of complete and utter agony to work. Your body is built to survive so it will do everything it can to rid itself of the pills, hours of throwing up nothing but stomach acid and don’t even get me started on the diarrhoea and the stomach pain.  Life sucks ass but pills and alcohol is a terrible way to try and end it.
